signal: Dovetail Software ranked #1 in Vendor Satisfaction and UX in the 2025-2026 HR Systems Survey and runs a Workday and Accenture partner ecosystem

email.body1:
Denise, saw Dovetail ranked #1 in Vendor Satisfaction and UX in the latest HR Systems Survey, on top of your Workday and Accenture partnerships.

A strong partner ecosystem usually surfaces more co-sell accounts than the team can personally work, so partner-sourced pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across the partner ecosystem on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Dovetail's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack data, and accounts showing those signals tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: three drafts to top partner targets
email.body2:
Denise, quick follow-up for Dovetail.

The hard part of co-sell is consistent, personalized outreach to the right accounts inside each partner's book, which is exactly what falls through the cracks at scale. That is where partner-sourced pipeline stalls.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to top accounts in your Workday ecosystem. Want to hop on a quick 15-minute call and I will walk you through them?
email.body3:
Denise, last bit of proof for Dovetail.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Dovetail's reply rate likely compares to other HR-tech players. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Denise, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling co-sell pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running partnerships is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your partner motion? I will tailor it to Dovetail either way.
